fields.description: Issue dated July 7, 1928 (No. 24), published in Miami, Florida. Coverage centers on Miami preparing for the B.P.O.E. (Elks) annual convention, emphasizing hospitality, tourism publicity, and warnings about scams and pickpockets. Includes humor and local commentary on nightlife and getting around town, notes on mosquitoes and street conditions, and discussion of city budget priorities (police/fire protection vs. publicity spending). Contains letters and items involving Director of Public Safety H. H. Arnold and other local figures, along with extensive local advertising and event promotions tied to the Elks’ visit.
